forecaster_note: Fri: a low in the Tasman sends better-quality SE swell — well overhead across most open beaches (head to the protected Sth corners for smaller); light westerlies keep it clean until a mid-arvo NE onshore switch, so aim for the AM high. Sat: swell eases slowly, NNW/NW winds add texture to exposed breaks; Sth-facing zones pick up the best sets at dawn. Sun: SE has eased right back — mixed NE/S windswells, S wind at dawn so tuck into a Sth corner. — Surfline forecaster (Fri 9 Oct)
